claim: Apple's revenue was at least $102.9 billion in Q3 2023.
summary: Apple's Q3 2023 revenue was about $81.8B on a fiscal-quarter basis and about $89.5B on a calendar-quarter basis, both well below $102.9B, so the claim is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Apple's revenue was at least $102.9 billion in Q3 2023.
sub_claims.note: From knowledge: Apple fiscal Q3 2023 (ended July 1, 2023) revenue was about $81.8B, and calendar Q3 2023 (Apple fiscal Q4 2023) revenue was about $89.5B. Both are below $102.9B, so at least $102.9B is false.
